notes: Version 11.40. This update fixes the background check for the phone's own system software. A built-in system part can no longer be called bad - or cleared - by an old saved check: it stays at Ask First with the reason shown plainly, the same on the check card, in the scan list and in Guided Clean, and the reason words are bigger and easier to read. Signing in, the scan, the verdicts and the threat list are unchanged. The phone build is 11.9.18.
